text: Cline: set API Provider to Ollama, base URL http://localhost:11434, pick a model. Ollama's page says use a context window of at least 32K for coding; Cline's own docs name no number but advise enabling Use Compact Prompt (Settings, Features), keeping tasks focused and starting a new task when context grows. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Ollama's VS Code integration is the Ollama extension from the VS Code Marketplace, surfacing models in the Chat model picker; it needs VS Code 1.127 or newer and finds models at http://127.0.0.1:11434 by default. Ollama 0.17.6+ is recommended for cloud sign-in. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: For local models in VS Code, Ollama's docs say to set context length to at least 64k in Ollama Settings and reload the window; VS Code may display a model's maximum context while Ollama allocates less at runtime. This is a larger floor than Cline's 32K recommendation. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Roo Code (while maintained) used Ollama's native API, read num_ctx from the Ollama model rather than setting it in the editor, and could run out of memory on first request because Ollama may allocate a larger context than expected. Fixes: pin num_ctx via Modelfile, preload with ollama run, use smaller quantizations, clear stale processes with ollama ps / ollama stop. (low confidence)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: JetBrains IDEs connect to Ollama via the AI chat sidebar: Set up Local Models, Third Party AI Providers, Ollama, Host URL http://localhost:11434. Ollama's page says a JetBrains AI Subscription is required. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Zed configures Ollama under language_models.ollama with api_url, auto_discover (default on), and available_models entries (name, display_name, max_tokens, supports_tools, supports_thinking, supports_images). Remote Ollama (cloud) uses api_url https://ollama.com plus an API key or OLLAMA_API_KEY. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Zed sends context length to Ollama as num_ctx with a default of 4096 tokens; raise it globally with context_window or per model with max_tokens. External Agents, terminal threads and Edit Prediction are configured separately. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Cline against Ollama cloud: enable Use custom base URL, set https://ollama.com, enter an ollama.com API key, and choose a cloud model that supports tool calling. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Roo Code announced closure on 2026-04-21. The extension, Cloud and Router ended 2026-05-15, and the GitHub repo was archived read-only that day. The Marketplace extension remains in its final state with no bug fixes or model updates. Treat Roo Code's Ollama provider docs as frozen. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Alternatives named after the Roo Code shutdown: Cline (where Roo originated), the community fork Zoo Code (github.com/Zoo-Code-Org/Zoo-Code), and Kilo Code, which reads existing .roomodes and .roo/rules files (rename .roo to .kilocode, re-enter API keys). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Continue configures Ollama in a YAML config (~/.continue/configs/config.yaml) via model blocks (uses: ollama/<model>), model: AUTODETECT, or manual provider: ollama with apiBase and roles. It does not auto-pull: a missing tag returns 404 until you run ollama pull with the exact tag. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Continue's Ollama guide warns agent mode needs tool support, which some models (e.g. DeepSeek R1) report as unsupported even with capabilities: [tool_use]; Continue may default to a large context causing memory errors, so lower contextLength. The guide was written against Ollama v0.11.x and Continue v1.1.x, so details may be dated. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code

text: Across editors, remote Ollama needs the client's base URL changed from localhost; Continue also needs OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434 on the server, and Roo's docs flag the base URL change for other machines. (medium confidence)
keywords: Editor integrations for Ollama: Continue / Cline / Roo Code / Zed / JetBrains / VS Code
